selection_rule: longest non-overlapping prefix/suffix pair; maximum total length, then N length, then C length, then lexical
unknown_behavior: exhaustive one-residue identity fallbacks guarantee valid-amino-acid coverage without heldout fitting; otherwise fail closed

provenance.anchor_fit: locked train rows only; V/J calls restrict candidate support but are not runtime inputs

N.candidate_rule: train-only literal N flanks length 2..8; total support >= 50 and support within at least one annotated gene >= 25; exhaustive one-residue identity fallbacks

C.candidate_rule: train-only literal C flanks length 2..8; total support >= 50 and support within at least one annotated gene >= 25; exhaustive one-residue identity fallbacks
